paragraphs: University of Portsmouth is a public university on England's south coast, with all faculties in central Portsmouth. Founded as Portsmouth Polytechnic in 1869, it gained university status in 1992. Strengths include criminology + forensics (top in UK), engineering, marine science, business, and computer science. TEF Gold for teaching.

International students enter via International College Portsmouth (ICP) — Navitas's pathway college in central Portsmouth. Foundation and Pre-Master programs lead into a Portsmouth Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: University of Portsmouth — государственный университет на южном побережье Англии, все факультеты в центре Портсмута. Основан как Portsmouth Polytechnic в 1869, статус университета — с 1992. Сильные направления: криминология + forensics (топ UK), инженерия, marine science, бизнес, computer science. TEF Gold за преподавание.

Международные студенты заходят через International College Portsmouth (ICP) — pathway-колледж Navitas в центре Портсмута. Foundation и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Portsmouth.
